breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The original prompt requested a solution at T=1.1, which was outside the specified time domain of t in [0, 1.0]. The ground truth corrected this by changing the final time to T=1.0. The agent correctly identified this conflict and set the final time to T=1.0 in the generated specification, stating 'Use the time domain t in [0,1.0] with final time T=1.0'.
